label: Defining clocks
subgoals: Define each primary clock with create_clock
Derive divided or multiplied clocks with create_generated_clock
Add latency and uncertainty appropriate to the stage of the flow

label: Constraining the block boundary
subgoals: Give each input port an arrival with set_input_delay
Give each output port a budget with set_output_delay
Model the drivers and loads at the ports with set_driving_cell and set_load

label: Object queries and units
subgoals: Select every constrained object with an explicit object query
Interpret every number in the library's time unit
Run constraint checks for unmatched objects and unconstrained ports
